title: Apple could launch redesigned MacBook Air with OLED as early as 2027
summary: Apple could launch a redesigned MacBook Air with an OLED display in 2027
detailed: Apple may launch its first OLED-equipped MacBook Air in late 2027 or 2028, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
Prior to the OLED release, Apple plans to refresh the MacBook Air lineup with M6 processors in 13-inch and 15-inch models during spring 2027.
The current MacBook Air uniform-thickness design was introduced in 2022 with the M2 chip and expanded to 15 inches in 2023.
Current pricing for Apple's M5 MacBook Air starts at $1,299, while the cheapest OLED MacBook Pro is priced at $2,899.
sentences: Apple may launch its first MacBook Air with an OLED display as early as next year.
Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman revealed in the latest episode of his Power On podcast that Apple is preparing a major redesign of its thin-and-light laptop for late 2027 or 2028.
Before that happens, Apple plans to refresh its MacBook Air lineup with the M6 processor in spring 2027.
The new 13-inch and 15-inch models, internally known as J913 and J915, respectively, will reportedly launch alongside the second-generation MacBook Neo.
Gurman does not expect major design changes for this generation.
Apple introduced the current MacBook Air design in 2022 with the M2 processor, replacing the wedge-shaped chassis with a uniform thickness design.
The company expanded the series with a 15-inch model in 2023.
Gurman previously suggested that Apple would introduce OLED displays to the MacBook Air series in 2028 at the earliest.
Last month, the reporter confirmed that Apple was internally testing OLED-equipped MacBook Air and iMac models.
The latest information suggests the MacBook Air redesign could arrive earlier.
Launching two MacBook Air generations in one year would be unusual, but Apple did precisely that with its MacBook Pro series in 2026.
The company released its M5 Pro and M5 Max refresh in March before introducing redesigned models with PROLED XDR displays in October.
It is unclear whether the OLED MacBook Air will inherit touchscreen support or other display features from the new MacBook Pro.
Apple currently sells the M5 MacBook Air starting at $1,299, while its cheapest OLED-equipped MacBook Pro costs $2,899.
